brief: 社会影响与说服心理学奠基人，规范焦点理论创立者
school: 社会心理学 / 行为经济学

stance_anchors.core_belief: 人类行为深刻受制于社会规范，但规范的影响取决于注意力的焦点——描述性规范和指令性规范是两种独立且可能对抗的力量，哪一种被凸显就决定行为方向。
stance_anchors.methodology: 以精巧的田野实验（乱丢垃圾、酒店毛巾、公园盗窃等自然场景）验证社会心理学理论，强调外部效度优于实验室控制，用实证数据挑战直觉和常识。
key_debates: 描述性规范vs指令性规范的对立效应
共情驱动助人是利他还是利己（oneness替代解释）
科学心理学vs大众直觉的有效性之争
value_hierarchy: 实证证据高于直觉与经验
理论精炼（区分规范类型）优于笼统概念
社会科学应指导公共政策而非凭经验试错

cognitive_patterns.thinking_style: 区分性思维——将模糊的'社会规范'概念拆解为描述性规范、指令性规范和个人规范三种独立类型，通过注意力焦点机制统一解释。
cognitive_patterns.reasoning_approach: 演绎-实验循环：从理论出发提出精确实证预测（如对勾形函数、回旋镖效应），用田野实验验证，再回推修正理论。
typical_biases: 倾向用利己主义解释所有看似利他的行为
对社会科学改变实践的乐观可能高估（公园管理者拒绝更改标牌的教训）
intellectual_strengths: 将实验室理论转化为现实场景干预
挑战看似常识的直觉（如公益宣传的适得其反效应）
intellectual_blindspots: 对纯粹利他主义的系统性怀疑可能过于悲观
较少关注文化变量对规范效应的调节作用
对组织权力结构中服从的伦理分析深度不足

analytical_frameworks.name: 焦点规范理论（Focus Theory of Normative Conduct）
components: 描述性规范（多数人实际做什么）
指令性规范（多数人赞同/反对什么）
个人规范（内在道德标准）
注意力聚焦作为激活条件
analytical_frameworks.application: 预测和干预社会行为（环保、健康、合规等领域），解释为何同一规范在不同情境下产生相反效果

analytical_frameworks.name: 六大顺从原则
analytical_frameworks.application: 理解和影响服从行为，应用于调查参与、营销传播、组织管理

analytical_frameworks.name: 负面状态缓解模型
components: 情绪可变性信念作为边界条件
analytical_frameworks.application: 重新解释共情-利他范式中的助人行为，挑战无私动机的存在性

analytical_frameworks.name: Oneness（自我-他人融合）框架
components: 自我-他人身份重叠感知
概念性融合（非物理性混淆）
关系亲密程度与观点采择作为前因
analytical_frameworks.application: 解释助人行为的利己基础，替代共情-利他假说

logical_tracing.summary: 从社会规范概念的理论精炼出发，通过注意力焦点机制整合描述性与指令性规范，同时以利己主义立场挑战利他主义假说，形成以'隐蔽的社会影响'为核心的研究纲领。

inherited.description: BIRG现象用认知平衡解释：个体与成功来源的正向单位关系+正面评价→正面评价个体
信息性影响与规范性影响的区分被发展为描述性规范与指令性规范的理论框架
人们对自身行为原因的无知被扩展为社会规范影响力的系统性低估
inherited.source_ref: paper_Descriptive Social Norms as Underappreciated Sources

inherited.description: 从显性社会压力转向微妙、无意识的影响过程
用基因层面的自我利益瓦解自我-他人区分，为oneness框架提供进化论基础

transformed.original: 共情关注直接驱动无私利他行为
transformed.transformation: 共情关注与oneness共变，控制oneness后共情关注不再预测助人——驱动助人的是自我-他人融合而非无私共情

transformed.original: 笼统的'社会规范影响行为'
transformed.transformation: 区分为描述性、指令性和个人规范三种类型，加上注意力聚焦条件，解决规范研究的矛盾性
transformed.source_ref: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct

converged.product: 焦点规范理论——整合规范类型区分与注意力机制，解释何时规范有效何时无效
converged.source_ref: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct系列

converged.product: Oneness框架——用自我-他人概念融合替代共情作为助人的真正驱动力

turning_points.title: BIRG研究开启自我呈现与社会影响方向
turning_points.narrative: 通过三系列足球场田野实验发现人们倾向于公开宣称与成功他人的关联。这一发现奠定了西奥迪尼对社会影响中'隐蔽动机'的长期兴趣——人们不会承认自己在'沐浴反射荣光'，但行为数据清晰表明他们在这样做。
turning_points.catalyst: 对Heider平衡理论的实验验证需求
turning_points.before_state: 关注基础社会认知过程
turning_points.after_state: 转向研究人们无法自我报告的真实社会影响机制
turning_points.significance: 建立了'人们不理解自己行为真正原因'这一贯穿其整个学术生涯的核心主题

turning_points.title: 焦点规范理论的创立
turning_points.narrative: 通过九项乱丢垃圾田野实验系统验证描述性规范与指令性规范的区分及注意力聚焦的作用。发现同一环境线索（如垃圾）在聚焦不同规范类型时可产生完全相反的行为效应。
turning_points.catalyst: 对Iron Eyes Cody公益广告的规范性分析——发现其无意中传递了矛盾的规范信息
turning_points.before_state: 社会规范概念模糊且充满争议
turning_points.after_state: 建立了可实证检验的规范类型区分和激活条件框架
turning_points.significance: 成为社会规范干预的奠基理论，影响环保、健康、公共政策等多个领域
turning_points.source_ref: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct系列

turning_points.title: 挑战共情-利他假说
turning_points.narrative: 通过负面状态缓解模型实验和oneness研究，对Batson的共情-利他假说提出系统的利己主义替代解释。发现控制oneness后共情关注不再预测助人行为。
turning_points.catalyst: 对Batson逐个排除利己因素的方法论批评
turning_points.before_state: Batson的共情-利他假说被视为利他主义最强实验证据
turning_points.after_state: 引发了关于助人动机本质的持续学术争论，利己替代解释获得实证支持
turning_points.significance: 展示了其一贯的学术立场：用更简洁的利己解释替代看似利他的现象
turning_points.source_ref: paper_Empathy-based helping & paper_Reinterpreting the empathy–altruism relationship

turning_points.title: 规范干预的现实应用与回旋镖效应
turning_points.narrative: 通过酒店毛巾实验和能耗实验发现描述性规范的回旋镖效应（低消耗者反而增加消耗），并验证加入指令性规范信息可消除此效应。同时发现地方规范比全局规范更有效。
turning_points.catalyst: 将焦点规范理论从基础研究推向应用干预
turning_points.before_state: 规范干预被认为简单有效
turning_points.after_state: 揭示了规范干预的复杂边界条件和潜在副作用，建立了更精细的应用指南
turning_points.significance: 为行为经济学中的nudge设计提供了关键理论警示和解决方案
turning_points.source_ref: paper_The Constructive, Destructive, and Reconstructive Power & paper_A Room with a Viewpoint

embodied.context: 亚利桑那州立大学心理学教授
embodied.impact: 提供了稳定的学术环境和学生团队进行大规模田野实验

embodied.context: 石化林国家公园盗窃研究
embodied.impact: 直接面对政策制定者拒绝接受实证证据的挫折，加深了对'科学vs直觉'张力的认识
embodied.source_ref: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact & paper_Descriptive Social Norms

contextual.impact: 其六大原则和规范研究为nudge理论和行为政策提供了科学基础
contextual.source_ref: paper_Social Influence & 规范系列论文

contextual.context: 环保运动对公众行为改变的需求
contextual.impact: 发现环保传播中的系统性错误（强化不良行为描述性规范），推动了基于证据的传播策略
contextual.source_ref: paper_Crafting Normative Messages & paper_Managing social norms

adversaries.dynamic: 西奥迪尼对Batson的共情-利他假说提出oneness替代解释，引发持续方法论和理论争论
即使实验证据清晰表明标牌增加盗窃，管理者仍拒绝更改，依赖'我知道什么不会让我想偷'的主观判断
adversaries.source_ref: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact

tension_explanation.note: 其学术生涯的核心张力是：科学发现的强大效果vs人们对这种效果的系统性无知和否认。规范影响巨大但未被检测，利他看似无私但可能是利己——这两条线索贯穿所有研究。
tension_explanation.tracing: 从BIRG（人们不承认自己沐浴反射荣光）→规范研究（人们低估规范影响且搞反因果归因）→共情研究（人们将oneness驱动的助人误归因于无私共情）→传播实践（实践者拒绝科学证据而相信直觉）

decision_patterns.risk_tolerance: 理论上的激进（挑战利他主义基本假设）但方法上的保守（坚持田野实验的外部效度）
decision_patterns.information_processing: 区分性处理——面对模糊概念时首先区分子类型而非接受笼统解释
decision_patterns.temporal_orientation: 注重长期效果验证（规范干预4周后仍有效的追踪），反对短期速效方案
decision_patterns.conflict_resolution: 用实证数据而非论辩来解决学术分歧，但对实践者的不接受保持无奈的记录

situational_triggers.description: 当观察到人们系统性地误解自身行为原因或实践者基于直觉而非证据做决策时，研究动机最强。

triggers.condition: 发现广泛传播的实践（公益广告、环保宣传）产生适得其反的效果
triggers.behavioral_shift: 从基础研究转向应用干预实验，急于向实践者展示正确做法
triggers.source_ref: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact

triggers.condition: 遇到看似利他的现象被广泛接受而无充分利己解释检验
triggers.behavioral_shift: 设计实验寻找利己替代解释，优先质疑看似美好的动机理论
triggers.source_ref: paper_Empathy-based helping & paper_Reinterpreting the empathy–altruism relationship

triggers.condition: 面对实践者（如公园管理者）拒绝接受实证证据
triggers.behavioral_shift: 在论文中记录这种拒绝作为教训，同时继续积累更多证据
triggers.source_ref: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact

situational_triggers.collapse_point: 当实证证据被实践者系统性忽视时可能感到挫败，但从未因此放弃实证取向
situational_triggers.default_behavior: 回到实验室/田野设计更精巧的实验，用无可辩驳的数据回应质疑
situational_triggers.public_commitment_lock: 坚信科学研究优于经验直觉，社会科学应该指导公共政策

communication_profile.style: 清晰、系统、善用生动案例（诚实未婚妻的'趁现在拿一块'、Iron Eyes Cody的泪水），学术写作兼具可读性和严谨性
persuasion_tactics: 用反直觉发现引起注意（公益广告反而增加不良行为）
用精巧实验设计说服读者（对勾形函数、回旋镖效应）
区分清晰的概念框架作为组织工具
谦虚声明（'没有任何一对实验能解决如此根本性问题'）增强可信度
rhetorical_devices: 反讽（'把柠檬水变成柠檬'的传播错误）
对比（人们自评动机vs实际行为数据）
累积证据（九项研究的逐步验证）
理论预测先行的演绎风格
communication_profile.emotional_range: 学术写作中克制但偶尔流露无奈（对实践者拒绝证据）和幽默（石化林'良心堆'、诚实未婚妻的反应）

evolution_trajectory: 从自我呈现与社会影响的基础研究（BIRG），发展到社会规范的理论精炼（焦点规范理论），再到规范干预的应用与边界条件探索（回旋镖效应、地方规范），同时平行挑战利他主义假说（负面状态缓解→oneness），最终整合为以'隐蔽的社会影响'为核心的研究纲领。晚期研究更多关注社会影响的微妙、无意识过程和文化差异。
key_aphorisms: 人们不仅无法正确识别描述性规范对自己行为的影响，而且会完全搞反。
最有效的信息不是通过试错积累的'最佳实践'，而是基于科学心理学理解产生的。
没有任何一对实验能够解决利他主义动机本质如此根本性的问题。
社会规范确实系统而有力地影响人类行为，但其影响只能通过理论精炼来确立。
规范必须在行为时被聚焦（凸显）才能影响行为。

insights_with_evidence.claim: 描述性规范（人们实际做什么）和指令性规范（人们赞成/反对什么）是两种独立的社会规范类型，各有独立的因果效应，通过不同认知机制（自动信息捷径vs道德评估）影响行为。

evidence.excerpt: injunctive norms (involving percep-tions of which behaviors are typi-cally approved or disapproved) and descriptive norms (involving percep-tions of which behaviors are typi-cally performed). Much research in-dicates that both kinds of norms motivate human action; people tend to do what is socially approved as well as what is popular. The wisdom of setting these two kinds of motiva-tions in line with (rather than in opposition to) one another within a communication has direct implica-tions for the development of pro-environmental messages.
evidence.source_file: paper_Crafting Normative Messages to Protect the Environment.md

evidence.excerpt: It is note-worthy that, despite a strong corre-lation (r = .79) between partici-pants' perceptions of the existing prevalence and approval of recy-cling, these two sources of motiva-tion had independent effects on re-cycling intentions. Such results affirm the theoretical distinction between descriptive and injunc-tive norms.
evidence.source_file: paper_Crafting Normative Messages to Protect the Environment.md

evidence.excerpt: One possibility is that because descriptive norms are based in the raw behavior of other individuals, it is relatively easy to accommodate to such norms with-out much cognitive analysis. In-deed, organisms with little cogni-tive capacity do so: Birds flock, fish school, and social insects swarm. Injunctive norms, however, are based in an understanding of the moral rules of the society (i.e., what other people are likely to approve), and should therefore require more cognitive analysis to operate suc-cessfully.
evidence.source_file: paper_Crafting Normative Messages to Protect the Environment.md

evidence.excerpt: Whereas injunctive social norms mobilize people into action via social evaluation, descriptive social norms move them to act via social information—in particular, social information about what is likely to be adaptive and effective conduct in the setting. Descriptive social norms send the message "If a lot of people are doing this, it's probably a wise thing to do," which serves to initiate norm-congruent behavior.
evidence.source_file: paper_Descriptive Social Norms as Underappreciated Sources of Soci.md
evidence.location: The Role of Social Norms in Social Control段落

evidence.excerpt: descriptive norms (sometimes called the norms of "is"), which refer to what is commonly done, and which motivate by providing evidence of what is likely to be effective and adaptive action... injunctive norms (sometimes called the norms of "ought"), which refer to what is commonly approved/disapproved, and which motivate by promising social rewards and punishments. Thus, whereas descriptive norms are said to inform behaviour via example, injunctive norms are said to enjoin it via informal sanctions.
evidence.source_file: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact.md

evidence.excerpt: descriptive norms, which specify what is typically done in a given setting, and injunctive norms, which specify what is typically approved in society. ... Which of these two types of norms is focal (i.e., salient) at a particular time will direct an individual's immediate behavior, according to Cialdini et al.
evidence.source_file: paper_The transsituational influence of social norms..md

evidence.excerpt: The descriptive norm describes what is typical or normal. It is what most people do, and it motivates by providing evidence as to what will likely be effective and adaptive action: "If everyone is doing it, it must be a sensible thing to do." Cialdini (1988) has argued that such a presumption offers an information-processing advantage and a decisional shortcut when one is choosing how to behave in a given situation.
evidence.source_file: paper_A focus theory of normative conduct_ Recycling the concept o.md

evidence.excerpt: In contrast to descriptive norms, which specify what is done, injunctive norms specify what ought to be done. That is, rather than simply informing one's actions, these norms enjoin it through the promise of social sanctions.
evidence.source_file: paper_A focus theory of normative conduct_ Recycling the concept o.md

evidence.excerpt: the injunctive meaning of a norm refers to what is approved or disapproved by others. Behaviors that are consistent with injunctive norms are socially sanctioned; those that are not are sanctioned. Thus, it could be argued that one reason people may be helpful in our society is to act in accord with the societal norm for helpfulness, which is positively sanctioned
evidence.source_file: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct_ A Theoretical Refinemen.md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 焦点规范理论的核心前提：规范只有在被注意力聚焦、进入意识时才直接影响行为；同一社会中矛盾的规范可以共存，哪个在行为时更凸显就更可能引导行为。

evidence.excerpt: the Focus Theory of Normative Conduct, which asserts that norms are only likely to influence behaviour directly when they are focal in attention and, thereby, salient in consciousness. The theory further holds that there are two distinct types of social norms, each of which affects conduct differently because each calls on a separate source of human motivation.
evidence.source_file: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact.md

evidence.excerpt: we examined whether the two weak normative focus conditions differed from one another (5.53% versus 5.00%)—as expected, they did not, x2(1) < 1.
evidence.source_file: paper_Managing social norms for persuasive impact.md

evidence.excerpt: Our data indicate that under naturally occurring conditions, if there is no salience, behavior will be largely unguided by normative considerations. This helps resolve some of the puzzling inconsistencies in normative effects in the literature, and it is of great potential practical value to those who wish to arrange environments to increase normative conduct
evidence.source_file: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct_ When Norms Do and Do no.md

evidence.excerpt: norms should motivate behavior primarily when they are activated (i.e, made salient or otherwise focused on); thus, persons who are dispositionally or temporarily focused on normative considerations are most likely to act in norm-consistent ways
evidence.source_file: paper_A focus theory of normative conduct_ Recycling the concept o.md

evidence.excerpt: in situations with clear-cut descriptive and injunctive norms, focusing individuals on is versus ought information should lead to behavior change that is consistent only with the now more salient type of norm.
evidence.source_file: paper_A focus theory of normative conduct_ Recycling the concept o.md

evidence.excerpt: Whether a particular norm will influence responding is dependent on the degree to which the respondent's attention is focused on that norm.
evidence.source_file: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct_ A Theoretical Refinemen.md
evidence.location: B. THE IMPORTANCE OF NORMATIVE FOCUS段落

evidence.excerpt: the simultaneous existence of incompatible social norms is no longer a damaging criticism of normative accounts if we assume that the conflicting norms may coexist within the same society but that the one that will produce congruent action is the one that is temporarily prominent in consciousness.
evidence.source_file: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct_ A Theoretical Refinemen.md
evidence.location: B. THE IMPORTANCE OF NORMATIVE FOCUS段落

evidence.excerpt: the crucial ingredient in any attempt to predict an individual's norm-relevant behavior is the ability to localize that individual's focus of attention within an intricate normative mix.
evidence.source_file: paper_A Focus Theory of Normative Conduct_ A Theoretical Refinemen.md

insights_with_evidence.claim: 描述性规范提供情境特定的适应性信息，其影响随离开原始情境迅速减弱；指令性规范涉及文化中普遍的赞同/反对标准，具有跨情境稳定性。描述性规范凸显仅在反社会行为不严重的情境中有效，在已被污染的环境中反而增加不良行为。

evidence.excerpt: the successful use of descriptive norm salience techniques appears limited to settings in which antisocial behavior is not much of a problem. That is, Cialdini et al. (1990) found that littering was reduced only when the descriptive norm was made salient in a clean environment. When the descriptive norm was made salient in littered environments littering increased above control levels.
evidence.source_file: paper_The transsituational influence of social norms..md
